name: Default
shortDescription: Lightweight BitTorrent client with a password-protected web UI, a background daemon and persistent settings and downloads.

alerts.message: Sign in with the generated DELUGE_WEB_PASSWORD from the environment settings, then connect to the local daemon (127.0.0.1:58846) in the Connection Manager. The password is only applied on the first start; change it later under Preferences > Interface. The peer port is not published, so peers are reached through outgoing connections only.
